title: "Game Simulator"
format: html
editor: visual

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
kclData <- read_csv("KCLStats2024.csv")
```

Make a test input roster from the KCL data
```{r}
roster <- kclData |> 
  rename(FirstName = `First Name`,
         LastName = `Last Name`,
         PA = `Plate Appearances`,
         BA = `Batting Average`,
         OBP = `On-base Percentage`,
         SLG = `Slugging Percentage`) |> 
  filter(Team == "Merchants 2024",
         FirstName != "HR",
         PA > 10) |> 
  mutate(Name = paste0(FirstName, " ", LastName)) |> 
  select(Name, PA, BA, OBP, SLG) |> 
  mutate(Position = NA)

```

Filter out Home Run Derbies from KCL Data
```{r}
kclData <- kclData |> 
  rename(FirstName = `First Name`,
         LastName = `Last Name`,
         PA = `Plate Appearances`) |> 
  filter(
    ! FirstName %in% c("DERBY", "HR Derby 2", "HR Derby 3", "HR Derby 1", "Derby", "HR")
  )
```

Quickly calculate the %  of extra bases that is made up of doubles, triples, or home runs in KCL
```{r}
kclData |> 
  filter(PA > 0) |> 
  summarize(
    HR = sum(`Home Runs`),
    Triples = sum(Triples),
    Doubles = sum(Doubles)
  )


```


Create percentages of each outcome
```{r}
roster <- roster |> 
  mutate(
    p_BB = OBP - BA,
    ISO = SLG - BA,
    p_HR = .1453 * ISO,
    p_3B = .1674 * ISO,
    p_2B = .6872 * ISO,
    p_1B = BA - (p_HR + p_3B + p_2B),
    p_out = 1 - OBP,
    )
```


Simulate a PA function
```{r}
simulatePA <- function(player) {
  events <- c("out","walk","single","double","triple","HR")
  probs  <- with(player, c(
    p_out,
    p_BB,
    p_1B,
    p_2B,
    p_3B,
    p_HR
  ))
  sample(events, size = 1, prob = probs)
}
```


Simulate runs scored in an inning given a lineup
```{r}
simulateInning <- function(lineup, start_i) {
  bases <- c(0,0,0)   # [1B, 2B, 3B]
  outs  <- 0
  runs  <- 0
  N     <- nrow(lineup)
  i     <- start_i

  while (outs < 3) {
    ev <- simulatePA(lineup[i, ])
    
    if (ev == "out") {
      outs <- outs + 1
    } 
    else if (ev == "walk") {
      # walk: batter to first, force‐advance runners
      if (bases[1] == 1) {
        # first is occupied → force
        if (bases[2] == 1) {
          # second occupied → force
          if (bases[3] == 1) {
            runs <- runs + 1
          } else {
            bases[3] <- 1
          }
        }
        bases[2] <- 1
      }
      bases[1] <- 1
    
    } else {
      # how many bases the batter earns
      hits <- switch(ev,
                     single = 1,
                     double = 2,
                     triple = 3,
                     HR     = 4)
      # score any runners forced past 3rd
      runs <- runs + sum(bases * (seq_along(bases) + hits >= 4))
      
      # slide existing runners
      newBases <- c(0,0,0)
      for (b in 3:1) {
        if (bases[b] == 1) {
          newpos <- b + hits
          if (newpos <= 3) newBases[newpos] <- 1
        }
      }
      # place the batter (or score on a homer)
      if (hits < 4) {
        newBases[hits] <- 1
      } else {
        runs <- runs + 1
      }
      bases <- newBases
    }
    
    # advance to next batter (wrap around)
    i <- if (i < N) i + 1 else 1
  }
  
  list(runs = runs, next_i = i)
}

```

Simulate Game
```{r}
simulateGame <- function(lineup, innings = 9) {
  total_runs <- 0
  current_i  <- 1     # start with the #1 spot
  
  for (inning in seq_len(innings)) {
    res         <- simulateInning(lineup, current_i)
    total_runs  <- total_runs + res$runs
    current_i   <- res$next_i
  }
  
  total_runs
}
```


Genetic Algorithm
```{r}
library(GA)
library(parallel)

# 1) set up cluster, leaving one core free
ncores <- max(detectCores() - 1, 1)
cl     <- makeCluster(ncores)

# 2) export your data & simulation functions to the workers
clusterExport(cl, c("roster", "simulatePA", "simulateInning", "simulateGame"))

# 3) redefine fitness() to use parSapply instead of replicate()
fitness <- function(order) {
  lineup <- roster[order[1:9], ]
  reps   <- 500
  
  runs <- parSapply(
    cl,
    1:reps,
    function(i) simulateGame(lineup)
  )
  mean(runs)
}

# 4) run the GA as before
N <- nrow(roster)
GAout <- ga(
  type      = "permutation",
  fitness   = fitness,
  lower     = 1,
  upper     = N,
  popSize   = 50,
  maxiter   = 100,
  run       = 50,
  pmutation = 0.2,
  elitism   = 2
)

# 5) clean up the cluster
stopCluster(cl)

# 6) pull out and inspect your optimized 9-hole
bestOrder      <- GAout@solution[1, ]
optimizedLineup <- roster[bestOrder[1:9], ]
print(optimizedLineup)
```
```{r}
reps_final <- 1000
final_runs <- replicate(reps_final, simulateGame(optimizedLineup))
mean(final_runs)
quantile(final_runs, c(0.025, 0.975))

```
